verses.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

xrefs.text: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.

verses.text: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

xrefs.text: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
“I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come— the Almighty.
The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.

verses.text: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

xrefs.text: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
Alas, the tumult of many peoples; they rage like the roaring seas and clamoring nations; they rumble like the crashing of mighty waters.
Who is this, rising like the Nile, like rivers whose waters churn?
Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.

verses.text: Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.

xrefs.text: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
and I declared: ‘You may come this far, but no farther; here your proud waves must stop’?
You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.

verses.text: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.

xrefs.text: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
“Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
